x: A positive integer leg of the Pythagorean triple.
y: A positive integer leg, chosen to be the even leg in the forward direction.
m: The larger positive parameter in the Euclidean representation.
n: The smaller positive parameter in the Euclidean representation.
p: A prime integer used in divisibility arguments.
d: the greatest common divisor of z-y and z+y
a: the positive odd square root of z+y
b: the positive odd square root of z-y
r: The positive odd integer whose square is z+y.
s: The positive odd integer whose square is z-y.
q: a prime divisor used in the converse
